senses.gloss:
भज् भज्, i. I, Par. Ātm.
 1. To divide, Man. 9, 104.
 2. To obtain as one's share, to obtain, Man. 10, 59 (Ātm.); to get, Śāk. d. 167; Pañc. 69, 4 (Par.).
 3. To take, MBh. 4, 237 (Ātm.); to embrace, Śāk. d. 107 (Ātm.); to love, Lass. 44, 7.
 4. To go to, Rām. 1, 16, 28; with दिशस्, To run away, MBh. 3, 11113.
 5. To take possession of, Man. 1, 28.
 6. To possess, to have, Man. 5, 148.
 7. To enjoy carnally, to love, Man. 9, 70.
 8. To make advances, Man. 8, 365.
 9. To serve, to worship, MBh. 3, 16004.
 10. Ātm. To favour, Pañc. i. d. 41.
 11. To practise, Man. 4, 204.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भक्त,
 1. Attached, devoted, Hit. ii. d. 74; believing; तद्-, believing in him, Rāmatap. Up. 1, 94.
 2. Served.
 3. Dressed, cooked. m. A follower, a votary; cf. also s. v. भक्त.
 --Comp.
 --Caus., with दिशस्, To put one to flight, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 80.
 --† i. 10, Par.
 1. To give.
 2. To dress, or cook.
 --With the prep. निस् निस्, To exclude, Man. 9, 207.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To return to (acc.), Daśak. in Chr. 193, 5 (anomal. भजिष्यति).
 --With वि वि,
 1. To distribute, to divide, Man. 9, 164.
 2. To put up severally, Vikr. d. 43.
 3. To distinguish, Rām. 2, 67, 31. विभक्त, Attached, Śāk. d. 107; Vikr. d. 160.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, To divide, MBh. 3, 16147. प्रविभक्त,
 1. Formerly distributed, Śāk. d. 165.
 2. Divided, Man. 8, 166.
 --With संवि सम् [] -वि,
 1. To make one partake of something, Rājat. 5, 109.
 2. To divide, Pañc. 217, 12. संविभक्त, Divided, parted.
 --Caus. To cause to be divided, MBh. 3, 12683.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. famulus, familia; Goth. anda-bahti, and bahtjan; also ϕώγω, ϕώγνυμι, and A.S. bacan; O.H.G. bachan (but see पच्).
† 1. भाज् भाज्, i. 10, Par. To divide; cf. भज्.

2. ऽभाज् -भाज्, (vb. भज्), latter part of comp. adj. One who possesses or obtains; e. g. अर्ध- adj. Obtaining or entitled to a half, Man. 8, 239. [] नृप-मान-, Obtaining royal honour, Man. 2, 139. विभाग-, m. Entitled to a portion of a property already distributed, as a son born after the distribution of his father's property. वियोग-, adj. Suffering separation, cf. also Pañc. i. d. 196; 147, 12.

भजन भज् + अन, n.
 1. Sharing.
 2. Possession.
 3. Service, adoration.

भाजन भाजन, भज् + अन, n.
 1. Any vessel, as a pot or cup, Hit. pr. d. 8, M.M.; figuratively, Pañc. ii. d. 194 (a vessel of love and confidence, a person on whom one may depend).
 2. A fit person.
 3. Sharing.
 --Comp.
भाजनत्व भाजन + त्व, n. Condition of being a vessel, i. e. a fit object, Mālav. d. 83.
